notes.title: Release Stream - Watch the Developer play!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

today's the big day: You can now [b]go and explore the islands[/b] on PC/Mac here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049710/Minute_of_Islands/

It's available for [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/234861]PlayStation[/url] and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/minute-of-islands-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url], as well, and coming to [url=https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mw6lbk0v0n0]Xbox[/url] on June 15, 1 a.m. UTC.

It's been a long, sometimes bumpy, but always exciting journey and we are thrilled to see our game out in the wild now! We appreciate very much that you stuck with us even when things didn't go according to plan and we had to postpone the original release date.

[b]We'd like to take the opportunity to thank every single one of you for accompanying Mo's and our way to release![/b]

Of course, we also have a brand-new trailer for you which was featured on the "Future Games Show" today – check it out!

[previewyoutube=V6V7AZCRYBQ;full]https://youtu.be/V6V7AZCRYBQ
[/previewyoutube]

[b]If you buy Minute of Islands and have a good time with it, please consider leaving a review on your favorite store and spreading the word on social media. It would help a lot![/b]

If you want to share your feedback, ideas and/or love with us, you can do so on [url=https://twitter.com/MinuteofIslands]Twitter[/url], [url=https://fb.me/MinuteofIslands]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/mixtvisiongames/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1049710]Steam Community Hub[/url], or just leave a comment here. 

We can't wait to find out how you're going to like your trip to the islands!

Take care
– Team [b]Minute of Islands[/b]

notes.title: Minute of Islands - Release aufgrund "technischer Probleme" vorerst verschoben
notes.notes:
Mixtvision und Entwickler Studio Fizbin haben den Releasetermin zum vielversprechenden Puzzle-Platformer Minute of Islands vorerst verschoben. Als Grund werden technische Probleme geanannt, die während der letzten Testrunde aufgetreten sind. Die ursprünglich für den 18. März geplante Veröffentlichung für PC und Konsolen wird [...]

notes.title: Minute of Islands' Release Postponed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We all know (especially after a year of a global pandemic) that things don’t always go according to plan. This is, unfortunately, the case with Minute of Island, which has hit some unforeseen snags. As much as we had fully hoped and intended to bring Minute of Islands to stores on March 18, some significant last-minute issues appeared during our last round of testing. This means that it’s with a heavy heart that we’ve decided to push the release on all platforms to a later date. 

As you can appreciate, we want to give you the best possible gaming experience Rest assured that the extra time invested is spent in your best interest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590278/69f41ad14a3e8d7f85d67e18f4196798bf69e35a.png[/img]

As we don’t want to disappoint you or make any false promises, we’re reluctant to set a fixed new date for the release until we’re 110% sure that all known bugs have been fixed that could affect the players’ experience. We’ll let you know about any updates as soon as possible - here as well as on Twitter and Facebook.   

We appreciate your patience and hope you’ll bear with us and remain as excited as we are for Minute of Islands’ final release. 

Take care
 - Team [i]Minute of Islands[/i]

notes.title: The Inner World dev sets March release date for "poetic" narrative puzzler Minute of Islands
notes.notes:
Studio Fizbin, the developer behind acclaimed point-and-click adventure series The Inner World, has set an 18th March release date for its striking "narrative puzzle platformer" Minute of Islands, which is coming to Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Mac, and PC.

Minute of Islands charts the adventures of a young engineer named Mo as she attempts to save the archipelago of her home, once inhabited by a race of giants, from encroaching disaster.

"Otherworldly but vital machines, festering in the underbellies of the islands themselves, must be kept going or an almost forgotten threat will swallow all," explains Minute of Islands' Steam page. "Mo vows to restore the hidden engines in time, but is this truly what she needs?".
